requirements.name: The page offers the address book as a plain list, each option showing its address, with none chosen in advance

scenarios.name: The page presents its list with no address chosen

tests.test: leaves the contact address unchecked on load
renders the address-book contacts and feature copy
tests.notes: this is what surfaced the address-summary detail — asserts every option's name and postal-address text

requirements.name: A chosen contact address is copied onto the notification and shown as the current contact

scenarios.name: Choosing a contact address saves without error and is shown as the current contact on return

tests.test: a chosen contact address is shown as the current contact on return, still chosen, and saving again keeps it
accepts a valid contact address and goes on to check your answers
tests.notes: proves the save and the landing on check your answers

tests.test: selects a valid contact, redirects and shows it as the current contact, still selected, on return

requirements.name: The contact address is optional, and saving without one is never refused

scenarios.name: Saving with no address chosen is allowed and goes to check your answers

tests.test: Should go on from Contact address to nothing, the review page being the fallback
tests.notes: the next-page rule past the last step

tests.test: contact address saved with no address chosen goes to check your answers, naming what is outstanding
tests.notes: the landing on the review is red then green with the review no longer the end of the journey (workareas/shared/eudpa-774/logs/inc-027-probe-kit-review-e2e); the review shows an error summary here

scenarios.notes: The Then 'no error summary is shown' cannot be witnessed: for the notification the test reaches the review is shown with an error summary naming what is outstanding, the contact address among it, as SCN-FLOW-003-B says. The landing on check your answers is proven.

requirements.name: An invalid submitted option is refused without preserving it

scenarios.name: An invalid selection is rejected and not preserved

tests.test: contact validation: when the submitted option is invalid, links to and focuses the group without preserving an invalid selection
tests.notes: this test is what surfaced the requirement itself — a tampered/invalid value was previously undocumented; not exercised anywhere in E2E
